scope: Selected UMF source inspection, not native extension dependency closure or Truss execution
copyObservation: copyJson counts at most 100000 visited values and depth 128 per invocation, rejects cycles/getters/custom prototypes and unsafe numeric values; selector copies full input and final source/selection/boundary result. These bounds are not Truss cumulative allocation/work or native heap qualification.
ownerFixtureInspection: Authored selector cases retain repeated annotations/full source, support valid-but-incomplete unknown scalar metadata, terminate explicit core cycles and keep selected/source/query copies independent. Owner tests were inspected, not rerun by Truss.
verificationBoundary: verifyCoreElementSelection recomputes consistency with receipt-retained source/query and caller registry; it does not prove authenticity of that source or original Truss admission.
